tl: Hindi na-update ang password. Subukan ulit.
Nilo-load ang mga asset ng laro

en: No Internet. Download game assets once while online.
tl: Walang koneksyon. I-download muna ang mga asset habang online.

en: Tip: Check the sender's full address
column4: Tip: Tingnan ang buong address ng nagpadala

en: Tip: A link's text can say anything. The destination is what matters.
tl: Tip: Kahit ano ang nakasulat sa link

en: Tip: Urgency is a pressure tactic. Slow down and verify.
tl: Tip: Ang pagmamadali ay taktika. Dahan-dahan at i-verify.

en: Tip: No legitimate staff will ever ask for your OTP.
tl: Tip: Walang lehitimong staff ang hihingi ng iyong OTP.

en: Quit Level Blue? Your progress this session is saved.
tl: I-quit ang Level Blue? Naka-save ang progress mo.

en: Your avg. BKT P(L) is %.1f%%.%s A peer mentor has been dispatched to help.
tl: Ang avg. BKT P(L) mo ay %.1f%%.%s May peer mentor na ipinadala para tumulong.

en: Choose how you want to deploy

tl: Alex: Alas-siyete bente na?! Huli na ako!

en: Alex: Shirt. Jacket. Bag. Come on!
Alex: Please don't let me miss the bell!
tl: Alex: Sana umabot ako bago tumunog ang bell!

en: Welcome! Tap DEPLOY to practice the phone, decisions and defense. Your real stages are safe.
tl: Maligayang pagdating! I-tap ang DEPLOY para magsanay sa phone, desisyon at depensa. Ligtas ang totoong stages mo.

en: This floor is training. It is not Stage 1. Nothing here locks your real stages.
tl: Pagsasanay ito. Hindi ito ang Stage 1. Walang naka-lock dito.

en: Story missions combine investigation, decisions and defense. This is a practice drill.
tl: May pagsisiyasat, desisyon at depensa sa story missions. Pagsasanay ito.

en: Quiz first. Correct answers pay gold. Misses spawn more enemies.
tl: Quiz muna. Tama = ginto. Mali = dagdag na kaaway.

en: Build next. Gold buys towers. You can move a tower for 1G.
tl: Build. Ang ginto ay pambili ng tower. Pwede mo itong ilipat sa halagang 1G.

en: Defend last. Enemies walk the path. Hearts are your base. Empty hearts and you fail.
tl: Defend. Dumadaan ang kaaway sa path. Hearts ang base mo. Kapag ubos

en: That's the loop. Next we run a live quiz on this floor.
tl: Iyan ang loop. Sunod ay live quiz dito sa floor.

en: That's the trap. Pick the safe call.
That's quiz. Gold for hits. Extra packets for misses. Next we build.
tl: Iyan ang quiz. Tama = ginto. Mali = dagdag na packet. Build ang susunod.

en: Drag NODE onto a pad. Cap 2/2. 2G each. Move costs 1G.
tl: I-drag ang NODE sa pad. Cap 2/2. 2G bawat isa. Lipat = 1G.

en: Capacity rank 1 is live. Place the second node.
tl: Live na ang Capacity rank 1. Ilagay ang pangalawang node.

en: Two up. Tap a tower then a pad to move it for 1G. Defend comes next.
tl: Dalawa na. I-tap ang tower tapos ang pad para ilipat (1G). Defend ang susunod.

en: That's defend. Empty hearts fail a live stage. Training still moves on.
tl: Iyan ang defend. Ubos na hearts = talo sa totoong stage. Dito

en: Capacity Rank 1 is yours. Open Upgrades to see the four Basic Node tracks.
tl: Sa iyo na ang Capacity Rank 1. Buksan ang Upgrades para sa apat na track ng Basic Node.

en: Tap Capacity Rank 1. Already owned. That's your first Basic Node track.
tl: I-tap ang Capacity Rank 1. Owned na. Unang track iyan ng Basic Node.

en: Research upgrades stay with you. Next, try one lesson from the Learning Journey.
tl: Mananatili ang research upgrades mo. Subukan ang isang lesson sa Learning Journey.

en: Each lesson has Learn, Quiz and Simulation. Finish all three to unlock its next node.
tl: May Learn, Quiz at Simulation ang bawat lesson. Tapusin ang tatlo para buksan ang susunod na node.

en: Try the first lesson: Learn the clues, pass its Quiz, then investigate on the practice desktop.
tl: Subukan ang unang lesson: alamin ang clues, ipasa ang Quiz, at magsiyasat sa practice desktop.

en: Learn, Quiz and Simulation complete! Finish a module's lesson path to unlock its post-test. Pass that checkpoint to continue to the next module.
tl: Tapos ang Learn, Quiz at Simulation! Tapusin ang lesson path para buksan ang post-test. Ipasa iyon para magpatuloy sa susunod na module.

en: Tutorial complete! You practiced phone evidence, decisions, defense and a lesson. Open the Learning Journey to begin your module path. DEPLOY opens story missions when their requirements are met.
tl: Tapos na ang tutorial! Nagsanay ka sa phone, desisyon, depensa at lesson. Buksan ang Learning Journey para simulan ang module. DEPLOY para sa story missions kapag handa na.

en: Let's practice with Alex's phone. Check a message, choose a response, then try defense. This is not a scored stage.
tl: Magsanay gamit ang phone ni Alex. Suriin ang mensahe, pumili ng tugon, at subukan ang depensa. Walang score ito.

en: Use the checklist beside the phone: read Mail, inspect the sender and link, then compare Contacts. Confirm your evidence to see the choices.
tl: Sundin ang checklist sa tabi ng phone: basahin ang Mail, tingnan ang sender at link, at ihambing sa Contacts. Kumpirmahin ang ebidensya.

en: Safe choice! You verified through a trusted route. Next is a separate defense drill so you can practice the controls.
tl: Ligtas na tugon! Gumamit ka ng pinagkakatiwalaang paraan. Sunod ay hiwalay na pagsasanay sa depensa.

en: Risky choices keep your story HP but can trigger containment. Let's practice that defense now.
tl: Hindi nababawasan ang story HP sa risky na tugon pero maaaring kailanganin ang containment. Subukan natin ang depensa.

en: Failed choices cost 1 story HP. At 0 HP you have one last chance; another failure restarts the stage. This practice lets you try again.
tl: Bawas 1 story HP sa failed na tugon. Sa 0 HP ay may huling pagkakataon; ang susunod na pagkabigo ay restart ng stage. Dito ay puwede kang umulit.

en: Time ran out. In timed story decisions, waiting can count as a failed choice. No real progress was lost here.
tl: Naubos ang oras. Sa timed na desisyon ay maaaring failed ang paghihintay. Walang totoong progress na nawala rito.

en: Compare the email domain with the saved school contact. Trust that saved route, not the sender asking for your password.
tl: Ihambing ang domain sa naka-save na school contact. Pagkatiwalaan iyon, hindi ang sender na humihingi ng password.
Magsanay muna gamit ang Basic Node.

en: Place both Basic Nodes before spending gold on moves or upgrades.
tl: Ilagay muna ang dalawang Basic Node bago gumastos sa paglipat o upgrades.

en: BASE HP: stop packets before they reach home. Story HP is separate.
tl: BASE HP: pigilan ang packets bago makarating sa base. Hiwalay ang story HP.

en: Practice only / no mastery score or stage rewards
tl: Pagsasanay lamang / walang mastery score o stage rewards

en: You protected the base. Next, inspect your starter upgrade, then try Learn, Quiz and Simulation.
tl: Naprotektahan mo ang base. Suriin ang starter upgrade, saka subukan ang Learn, Quiz at Simulation.

en: No stage was lost. Place nodes where their range covers the path. Restart practice and try a stronger position.
tl: Walang stage na nawala. Ilagay ang nodes kung saan abot ang path. Ulitin ang pagsasanay sa mas magandang puwesto.

en: Story decisions can have a countdown. It starts after evidence is confirmed, and Logs do not stop it. Settings can extend or disable it. Choose using the clues, not the email's pressure.
tl: Maaaring may countdown ang desisyon. Nagsisimula ito matapos kumpirmahin ang ebidensya at hindi hihinto sa Logs. Puwede itong baguhin sa Settings. Gamitin ang clues sa pagpili.

en: Complete your baseline assessment before the command centre unlocks.
tl: Tapusin muna ang baseline assessment bago magbukas ang command centre.

tl: Hindi na-save ang pre-test. Subukan ulit.
